faq.question: What is the purity of BPC-157?
faq.answer: ≥99% by HPLC with ESI-MS identity confirmation. Every batch verified at our Shenzhen facility. Batch-specific COA included with every order.

faq.question: What is the molecular weight and sequence of BPC-157?
faq.answer: BPC-157 is a pentadecapeptide with MW ~1419.5 Da. Sequence: Gly-Glu-Pro-Pro-Pro-Gly-Lys-Pro-Ala-Asp-Asp-Ala-Gly-Leu-Val.

faq.question: How should I reconstitute and store BPC-157?
faq.answer: Reconstitute with sterile bacteriostatic water or 0.9% saline. Store lyophilized powder at 2-8°C. After reconstitution, aliquot and store at -20°C for up to 30 days.

faq.question: What is the minimum order quantity?

faq.question: What documentation is included with BPC-157?

faq.question: Is BPC-157 stable in solution after reconstitution?
faq.answer: Relatively stable in sterile water or PBS at 4°C for 1–2 weeks, but pH-dependent. Best practice: reconstitute in sterile water/PBS (pH 7.0–7.4), aliquot single-use portions, freeze at -20°C. Avoid freeze-thaw cycles. Lyophilized powder is significantly more stable than solution.

faq.question: What is the recommended solvent for reconstitution?
faq.answer: Sterile water for injection or phosphate-buffered saline (PBS, pH 7.4). BPC-157 is freely soluble in aqueous buffers at neutral pH. Avoid strongly acidic/basic solvents (catalyze hydrolysis). Do not use DMSO — it can interfere with bioassays.
